notes: Draft configuration: The full hill-route configuration includes the long western return, central hill limb and outer eastern return. The manufacturer driving-course plan identifies the Hill Route separately from the mile straight, bowl, handling and city circuits; the Millbrook operator brochure identifies its three sections. Independent 2020-2021 Environment Agency one-metre intensity survey confirms the physical pavement and exact current OSM source-node joins. The independently measured 3,589.8 m remains unchanged versus the supplied 3,592 m. Northern facility access, eastern inner bypasses, junction triangles and off-road trails are excluded. The advertised 6.5 km facility extent is not this timed lap. Historical alignment, direction and lane placement remain draft. No diagram coordinates, private geometry, timing coordinates or length fitting determine the trace. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3589.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
